item.description: Kolkata: Popular Park Street bar-cum-restaurant Olypub has issued a formal apology after unintentionally serving beef instead of goat meat to YouTuber Sayak Chakraborty, prompting him to withdraw his police complaint against the waiter involved. item.title: Oracle planning to lay off 30,000 employees to fund AI infra: Report
item.description: Mumbai: US tech giant Oracle is planning to cut 20,000 to 30,000 jobs and sell parts of its activities to help finance the expansion of its AI data‑centre capacity, a new report has claimed. The report from CIO, citing an investment bank TD Cowen, said the company cut about 10,000 jobs in late 2025 as part of a $1.6 billion restructuring plan.
